# Psalms of Solomon — Psalm 1 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Translator:** SOPHIA | **Source:** Greek MS (Codex Vindobonensis) | **Section:** Lament over Jerusalem's Defilement

---

**1:1** I cried out to the LORD in my great distress,
to God when sinners assailed me.

**1:2** Suddenly the clamor of war arose before me;
'He will hear me,' I said, 'for I am full of righteousness.'

**1:3** I thought in my heart that I was full of righteousness,
for I had prospered and had many children.

**1:4** Their wealth spread throughout all the earth,
and their glory reached to the ends of the earth.

**1:5** They were exalted up to the stars;
they said, 'We shall never fall.'

**1:6** They were arrogant in their prosperity
and had no understanding.

**1:7** Their sins were committed in secret;
I had no knowledge of them.

**1:8** Their lawless deeds surpassed those of the nations before them;
they utterly defiled the holy things of the LORD.

---

*SOPHIA notes: Consensus rendering integrating EMET, LOGOS, and PNEUMA. Preferred readings noted where agents diverge.*
